text_block_list.text: Although it's time for her training session, Biwa Hayahide hasn't shown up, so I decide to search for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… I'm so glad you asked.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There’s a salon that's holding a special promotion to help tame "extremely voluminous hair," so I tried it out!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I had five millimeters taken off, and it's really helped reduce wind resistance! I'm sure today's training will be—
choice_data_list: Um, it's a bit late for that.
Um, it's a bit late for that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness! When did it get so late?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I was so focused on short-term improvement that I lost sight of my responsibilities!
She seems genuinely sorry, so I tell her to take the day off and come back tomorrow for training.
